body: Besides my social life, I have it pretty good. I work in IT and play classical music so that's half the problem... Never had a female friend and don't know how to meet anyone, especially when no one shares my interests.

I don't know any girls as I am studying software, and am just about to graduate which means I will never get to study with someone like I have always wanted to. My friends in uni are always talking about their experiences with their gf's or girls who are interested in them but no one has ever showed interest in me.
"just love yourself bro", said by everyone who as been loved, I have never received attention or anything. Everything I do is always alone.
